details: In github.com/chrismellard/docker-credential-acr-env/pkg/credhelper, the regular expression used by isACRRegistry to validate Azure Container Registry hostnames is unanchored. As a result, arbitrary hostnames containing the substring ".azurecr.io" (such as evil.azurecr.io.attacker.com) are treated as valid ACR registries, causing ACRCredHelper.Get to send the Azure Active Directory (AAD) access token to attacker-controlled hosts.
summary: Credential leakage to untrusted hosts in github.com/chrismellard/docker-credential-acr-env
